item.title: Boost Your .NET Projects with Spargine: Simplify Thread Pool Execution with ThreadPoolHelper
item.description: Spargine's ThreadPoolHelper simplifies concurrent execution in .NET applications by providing reusable APIs that manage thread pool operations. It supports single and batch operations, bounded concurrency, timeout management, cooperative cancellation, and non-throwing execution. By centralizing common patterns, ThreadPoolHelper enhances maintainability and reduces repetitive infrastructure code for developers. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/09/02/boost-your-net-projects-with-spargine-simplify-thread-pool-execution-with-threadpoolhelper/

item.title: Collection Performance: Use Caution when using Range Expressions in Hot Paths when Collection Slicing
item.description: Range expressions make collection slicing concise, but they can introduce unexpected overhead in hot paths. This subscriber-only article compares several ways to create slices with Memory, Span, ReadOnlyMemory, and ReadOnlySpan—and explains when using start-and-length overloads may be the smarter performance choice. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/08/30/collection-performance-use-caution-when-using-range-expressions-in-hot-paths-when-collection-slicing/

item.title: Boost Your .NET Projects with Spargine: Simplify Entity Framework Core with DbContextExtensions
item.description: DbContextExtensions, part of the DotNetTips.Spargine.Extensions project, offers reusable methods for common Entity Framework Core data-access patterns. It reduces repetitive code and enhances consistency by providing methods for adding, deleting, and managing entities, executing transactions, and performing existence checks. This centralization minimizes maintenance costs and improves code clarity. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/08/26/boost-your-net-projects-with-spargine-simplify-entity-framework-core-with-dbcontextextensions/
